included: Bind the already-recorded frozen G1 plan baseline to immutable digests and timestamps.
Determine whether the frozen plan can still satisfy its declared slot-count, duration, and distinct-day gates without backfill or plan mutation.
Serialize the Sol stage-gate disposition and its authority boundary.
excluded: Reading or re-verifying the active G1 root.
Changing the active package, plan, registry, evidence, schedule, or old decision record.
Downloading data, adapting data, backtesting, paper trading, or live trading.
Evaluating market validity, theory validity, strategy profitability, or execution readiness.
Authorizing a replacement lane, recovery lane, deployment, paper execution, or live execution.

authority_binding.issuer_assertion: This record is issued by GPT-5.6-SOL-ULTRA_STAGE_GATE and is authoritative only for the decision_scope stated above.
authority_binding.delegation_boundary: No field in this record delegates Sol authority to another model, process, artifact, or future lane.

reasons: The producer was reported as GPT-5.6-TERRA-HIGH despite the Sol-labelled filename and decision_id.
The record does not contain an issued_by field.
The record does not bind a Sol stage-gate authority.
The record does not contain a canonical self digest.
supersession.preservation: The v1 bytes remain unchanged and are retained only as hash-bound historical baseline input.
supersession.authority_effect: v1 is not a Sol authorization, stage-gate decision, or future permission. This v2 record supersedes v1 only within the stated decision_scope.

baseline_fact_source.use_boundary: Only exact baseline facts required by the mathematical reachability proof are admitted; v1 conclusions and volatile observations are not inherited as authority.

immutable_artifact_bindings_as_recorded.binding_limit: These digests are bound exactly as recorded in the hash-bound v1 baseline; v2 does not assert a live reread of their source paths.

frozen_constraints: Missed and unqualified slots cannot be converted into qualified slots by backfill or rerun.
The active plan, registry, evidence, schedule, and qualification gates cannot be mutated to recover reachability.
Only already-qualified, active, or future slots may contribute to the mathematical upper bound.

unreachability_proof.logic: Because at least one mandatory gate has a finite maximum below its required threshold, the frozen plan cannot pass. Here both the slot-count gate and duration gate independently fail their upper bounds.

volatile_observations.interpretation: The differing observations demonstrate that launch state and free disk are volatile snapshots. Neither snapshot changes the frozen slot upper bound, repairs the plan, authorizes work, or grants permission to a future lane.
volatile_observations.future_rule: Any separately authorized future lane must obtain fresh operational observations under its own plan and authority; this record supplies none.

stage_gate_disposition.permitted_action: Preserve the frozen active G1 package, plan, registry, and evidence unchanged.
prohibited_actions: Backfill, rerun, or relabel missed or unqualified slots.
Lower, reinterpret, or bypass any G1 qualification gate.
Overwrite the active G1 package with the workspace package.
Modify the active plan, registry, evidence, schedule, or seal.
Treat volatile launch or disk observations as proof, recovery, or authorization.
Treat this v2 record as authorization for a new or replacement lane.

future_lane_boundary.relationship_to_active_g1: A future lane, if separately authorized, must be a new evidence program and cannot be represented as recovery or completion of the frozen active G1 plan.
minimum_separate_authority_requirements: A new plan identity and schedule.
A new registry and evidence root.
A separately sealed collector bundle and storage boundary.
No mutation or overwrite of the frozen active G1 artifacts.

claim_boundary.maximum_positive_claim: The hash-bound frozen-plan baseline admits at most 14 qualified slots and 51240 qualified seconds, both below mandatory G1 thresholds; therefore that exact frozen plan is mathematically unreachable without prohibited mutation or backfill.
